title: Couldn't wait so launching this first raw version
author: Interesting-Area6418
selftext:
I’ve launched a product that my brother and I have been building over the past 3 months, [Spriteloop](https://spriteloop.eastus2.cloudapp.azure.com/).

Spriteloop lets you convert 2D images into animations. This is the very first raw version, and we’re mainly putting it out to see how you all find it.

There are a few limitations we’re already aware of. Generation might be slow since we’re just starting out (and a bit GPU-poor lol), but we’ll improve that. Sometimes GPUs may not be available during high usage since we’re currently using RunPod serverless, but we’ll upgrade our tier if people like the product. There may also be inconsistencies in frames and post-processing, which we’ll continuously work on. That said, I can confidently say the motion quality is good.

I’d really appreciate it if you join our Discord if you’re interested in the product. It will help us better understand errors, gather feedback, and learn what breaks and what can be improved.

In this version, you can select frames after generation to create loops or refine animations, and you can also manually edit individual frames. We have many more interesting ideas coming soon, so do join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/dQNdpbXNzJ) :)
